title: Product Manager
description:
LotusFlare is a provider of cloud-native SaaS products based in the heart of Silicon Valley. Founded by the team that helped Facebook reach over one billion users, LotusFlare was founded to make affordable mobile communications available to everyone on Earth.

Today, LotusFlare focuses on designing, building, and continuously evolving a digital commerce and monetization platform that delivers valuable outcomes for enterprises. Our platform, Digital Network Operator (DNO) Cloud, is licensed to telecommunications services providers and supports millions of customers globally.

LotusFlare has also designed and built the leading eSIM travel product - Nomad. Nomad provides global travelers with high-speed, affordable data connectivity in over 190 countries. Nomad is available as an iOS or Android app or via getnomad.app.  
  
**Job Description and Responsibilities:**  
You will own the platform that helps our sales and marketing teams bring LotusFlare to life for CSPs, showing what our technology can do in the context of each customer's business. It is also a place to build and try new ideas that are not yet part of the core product, so we can learn what excites the market before we commit to them. You will report to the director of product and lead a team of four engineers.

What success looks like in the first year

* Sales and marketing can set up a tailored demo themselves, with far less engineering time per demo than today.
* Booth and call demos run reliably, with problems found before the client sees them.
* A working experiment track: ideas come in, get tested, and at least some graduate to the core roadmap or are retired with a clear reason.
* The four-person team delivers predictably, and sales and marketing trust the roadmap.

Responsibilities:

Discovery and roadmap: You turn what sales and marketing need into a prioritized roadmap and tickets the engineers can build from.

* Talk regularly with sales, pre-sales and marketing to learn demo pain points, upcoming client needs and conference plans.
* Balance two kinds of demos: live sales-call demos tailored to a specific CSP, and booth demos that must run reliably and with little supervision.
* Check each demo request against current DNO capabilities and decide what belongs on the platform roadmap, what is a one-off, and what is a request to the core product team.
* Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Create the demo process, user guides and training that drive adoption by non-technical users.

Experimental features: You run the part of the platform where we develop and host features that are not yet part of the core product, and test them before they reach it.

* Set up how experiments are proposed, selected and scoped, and keep them small enough to ship quickly.
* Define up front what each experiment must show, such as client reaction in demos, conference interest or sales feedback.
* Decide, with the evidence, whether an experiment graduates to the core product roadmap, continues, or is retired.
* Hand graduating features to the core product team with the context they need.
* Keep experiments clearly labeled so sales never presents an unreleased feature as available.

Technical partnership and demo quality: You work alongside engineering and do not own architecture decisions alone; you bring the product context and the tradeoffs.

* Work with the engineering lead and backend teams on API integrations and data flows between the platform and DNO systems.
* Define requirements for how AI tools and agents set up demo environments, generate demo data and build demo experiences, so sales can prepare demos with minimal engineering support.
* Take part in architecture discussions, understand the tradeoffs, and help the team make decisions.
* Work with engineering to keep demo environments, data and key journeys stable, with automated tests where they pay off, so every demo is client-ready.

Leading the team and delivery

* Lead a team of four engineers: set priorities, give feedback and support their growth.
* Run sprint planning, backlog refinement and retrospectives, using Scrum or Kanban as fits the team.
* Own delivery of features from requirements through to production release.
* Track dependencies on other teams, flag risks early and keep stakeholders informed of timelines.
* Report progress and results to leadership in plain, non-technical terms.  
    
  **Job Requirements:**  
  4+ years of product management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or platform products.
* Experience owning features or a product from discovery through delivery.
* Experience working with sales, pre-sales or marketing teams as users or stakeholders.
* Comfortable working daily with engineers and writing clear tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Working knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
* Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work, and the ability to prototype ideas quickly.
* Experience running sprint ceremonies for an engineering team.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
* Experience leading or mentoring people is a plus; if you have not managed engineers before, tell us how you have led without authority.

**Nice to have**

* Telecom or digital BSS domain knowledge.
* Experience building products for internal users.
* Familiarity with AI agents and MCP servers.
* Experience with demo tooling or conference and event demos.  
    
  **Benefits we have for you:**  
  + Competitive salary package
  + Paid lunch (In the office)
  + Private healthcare
  + Yearly bonus
  + Training and workshops
  + Truly flexible working hours
  + Top-of-the-class engineers to learn from and work with  
  **About us:**  
  At LotusFlare, we attract and keep amazing people by offering two key things:  
  + Purposeful Work: Every team member sees how their efforts make a tangible, positive difference for our customers and partners.
  + Growth Opportunities: We provide the chance to develop professionally while mastering cutting-edge practices in cloud-native enterprise software.  
  From the beginning, our mission has been to simplify technology to create better experiences for customers. Using an “experience down” approach, which prioritizes the customer's journey at every stage of development, our Digital Network Operator Cloud empowers communication service providers to achieve valuable business outcomes. DNO Cloud enables communication service providers to innovate freely, reduce operational costs, monetize network assets, engage customers on all digital channels, drive customer acquisition, and increase retention.  
    
  With headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and five major offices worldwide, LotusFlare serves Deutsche Telekom, T-Mobile, A1, Globe Telecom, Liberty Latin America, Singtel, and other leading enterprises around the world.  
    
  Website: www.lotusflare.com  
  LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lotusflare  
  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lifeatlotusflare/
    
  Twitter: https://twitter.com/lotus\_flare

title: Product Owner - Corporate & Individual US Taxation
description:
**Job Title:** Product Owner – Corporate & Individual US Taxation

**Role/Job Summary:**

We are looking for a highly experienced Product Owner with 12+ years of overall experience to own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for our Corporate & Individual US Taxation product suite. The role requires deep expertise in US federal and state tax compliance (individual and corporate/business tax) combined with strong Agile product ownership skills, to translate evolving IRS and state regulations, filing requirements, and tax-season deadlines into scalable, industry-leading tax products that CPA firms, businesses, and individual taxpayers rely on.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Corporate & Individual US Taxation product suite, aligned to IRS/state regulatory changes and business goals.
* Collaborate with tax subject matter experts, CPAs/EAs, compliance, legal, and business stakeholders to translate US federal and state tax regulations (individual, corporate, and partnership) into product features.
* Track IRS regulatory updates, annual tax law changes, state-specific tax rules, and filing form changes (Forms 1040, 1120 , 1120-S, 1065, W-2, 1099, etc.) and ensuretimelyreflection in the product.
* Own, create, andmaintaina well-groomed product backlog of epics, features, and user stories for corporate and individual US tax modules.
* Prioritize the backlog based on business value, IRS/state filing deadlines, tax-season readiness, and customer impact.
* Lead scrum teams by defining sprint goals, reviewing sprint outcomes, and ensuringtimelydelivery of tax product releases well ahead of tax season and statutory deadlines.
* Partner with engineering, QA, and compliance teams tovalidatethe accuracy of tax calculations, forms, and e-filing (IRS Modernized e-File/ MeF , state e-file) before release.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) with tax practitioners/CPAs and ensure production readiness of new tax rules, forms, and calculation logic each tax year.
* Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, tax experts, customers, and the technology/development team.
* Ensure all product featurescomply withIRS regulations, data privacy/security standards (e.g., IRS Publication 4557 safeguards), and audit requirements.
* Represent the product externally where needed (webinars, firm communications, customer advisory input) and track competitive/market developments in the tax technology space.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 12+ years of overall experience, includingsignificant experienceas a Product Owner/Product Manager/Business Analyst in a US tax, fintech, or financial compliance product environment.
* Strong working knowledge of US Corporate and Individual Taxation – federal and state individual tax (Form 1040 and schedules), corporate/business tax (Forms 1120, 1120-S, 1065), payroll/information reporting (W-2, 1099), and IRS e-filing ( MeF ) processes.
* In-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum processes and principles, including backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and release planning.
* Proven ability to translate complex US tax regulations and IRS guidance into clear, actionable product requirements.

* Outstanding communication, presentation, and leadership skills, with the ability tointerface withsenior stakeholders, CPAs/tax experts, and technical teams.
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail given the compliance-critical nature of tax products.
* Ability to manage conflicting stakeholder needs and prioritize based on regulatory deadlines and business impact, particularly around peak tax season.
* Hands-on experience with product management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps (ADO), Confluence, Miro, or similar.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* CPA, EA (Enrolled Agent), CTC, or equivalent US tax credential .
* Scrum/ SAFe /CSPO certification.
* Prior experience with US tax engines/platforms such as Thomson Reuters (ONESOURCE, GoSystem , UltraTax CS), Wolters Kluwer (CCH Axcess, CCH ProSystem fx ), Intuit (Lacerte, ProSeries , TurboTax), Drake Software, or Vertex.
* Experience with IRS Modernized e-File ( MeF ) schema, XML-based filing standards, and state e-file programs.
* Exposure to AI/ML-driven tax automation or RPA in tax return preparation/review.
* Experience working in a Big 4/national CPA firm, tax technology vendor, or financial services organization.
* Master's in Taxation , JD, or MBA (Finance) is a plus.

**Experience Required:**

12+ Years, with substantial experience specifically in Corporate and/or Individual US Taxation product ownership, tax technology, or financial compliance products.

**Any Other Important Notes:**

* Given the US tax domain focus, candidates should have strong familiarity with the US tax calendar and be available for extended hours/on-call support during peak filing seasons (Jan–Apr and the Sep–Oct extension window).
* Role mayrequireoverlap with US time zones for stakeholder collaboration, depending on team location.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skillsrequiredfor client/stakeholder-facing engagement.
* CPA/EA certification or equivalent US tax credential preferred; Agile/Scrum certification (CSPO, SAFe ) is an added advantage.
* Location, shift timings, and travel requirements to be confirmed by the hiring manager based on project/client needs.

title: Website Manager

description:

title: Vice President- Account Management Services Product Owner
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering”. You have found the right team.

As “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering Professional / Lead” within our “Asset & Wealth Management – MPX Account Management Services (Account SOR)” , you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

* **Lead** the Operate function for Account Management Services by owning day-to-day product stability, service delivery, and BAU point-of-contact coverage.
* **Partner** with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, and Service Management to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets, incidents, defects, and urgent ad-hoc requests with clear SLAs and communications.
* **Translate** recurring BAU issues and user feedback into product enhancements by defining requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans to improve user/client experience.
* **Establish** operating rhythms and performance metrics (e.g., ticket trends, root-cause themes, time-to-resolution) to drive continuous improvement and proactive risk/controls management.
* **Define** crisp problem statements, use cases, user journeys, success metrics, and acceptance criteria from complex requirements to enable fast, rigorous delivery.
* **Drive** the modernization roadmap across platform evolution, user experience improvements, and scalable operational processes.
* **Identify** AI and Agentic AI opportunities that increase straight-through processing and data quality with safe, explainable, and governable designs.
* **Partner** across Business, Operations, Technology, and Controls to remove blockers, force decisions, and accelerate delivery outcomes.
* **Sequence** work across teams, platforms, and release trains to manage dependencies and deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
* **Stand up** delivery and outcome metrics (quality, timeliness, adoption, STP lift, defect reduction, cycle time) to continuously reshape priorities and the roadmap.
* **Own** the product vision, roadmap, and execution for mission-critical data services powering onboarding, reporting, operational workflows, and investment processes.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Demonstrate** a proven track record as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Lead for data products, platforms, or critical enterprise services (ideally in a major financial institution).
* **Bring** a minimum of 10 years of Financial Services experience blending data, technology, and operations with Asset & Wealth Management data concepts.
* **Deliver** effectively in agile environments with backlog discipline, pragmatic scope control, and outcome-based execution.
* **Work** hands-on with SQL and Python to navigate large datasets, validate hypotheses, investigate issues, and partner credibly with engineering and analytics.
* **Apply** practical fluency with AI and Agentic AI for data products (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection, triage, metadata enrichment, exception handling, workflow orchestration) while evaluating value, risk, scalability, and controls.
* **Influence** stakeholders at every level with sharp written and verbal communication suitable for governance forums and senior leadership.
* **Hold** a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or a related field.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Bring** Asset Management experience with onboarding and servicing.
* **Use** foundational AI/developer tooling such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot within a modern engineering environment.
* **Show** familiarity with data-quality tooling, metadata platforms, lineage frameworks, and modern data platforms (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, distributed processing, APIs, and data services).
* **Earn** product management certifications such as CSPO or PSPO (preferred).
* **Hold** a Master's degree in engineering or computer science and demonstrate a creative mindset for innovative data-solution design.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

title: Product Manager, PLCS, Contract Lifecycle Management
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.**

You are responsible for ensuring that projects are successfully completed on time and on budget. This includes project governance, budget and timeline development, build quality, testing and operational readiness, and the completed project’s readiness to go live.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Drive consistency and quality in the execution of projects using the appropriate methodology and tools
* Identify, assess, and mitigate project-level risks and escalate them to global leads and/ or the program manager when needed
* Provide project reporting and status updates using scorecards, status reports and monthly review meetings and leading stakeholder meetings
* Lead budget management, resource planning and utilization
* Confirm the completion and consistency of projects and their readiness to go live
* Own the relationship with the external vendors including quality assurance in all phases of project delivery

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Proven experience in project management methodology
* Excellent communication skills and able to drive effective discussions with project resources from tactical execution level up to steering committee members
* Excellent project planning and proactiveness in identifying risks and mitigations and managing strict timelines
* Strong focus on cost, schedule and quality of project delivery
* Knowledge of relevant business processes and related technology solutions
* Stakeholder management and ability to influence positively in decision making
* Proven ability in building effective teams across internal and external partners
* Strong conceptual and analytic skills – enjoys problem solving

**About the Role**

The CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) Product Lead owns the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Mondelez International's CLM platform. Operating primarily within the DocuSign CLM ecosystem and connected procurement tools, this role bridges Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business stakeholders to drive adoption, optimize contract processes, and deliver measurable commercial value.

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and communicate the CLM product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with enterprise goals and MDLZ procurement transformation objectives.

* Establish product KPIs and success metrics, and report progress to senior stakeholders on a regular cadence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and own the Contract Product roadmap and strategy, translating business needs into a prioritized delivery plan.
* Drive CLM deployment across Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and other business functions, ensuring consistent adoption and change management.
* Oversee ongoing platform support, including issue resolution, enhancement requests, and release management.
* Lead contract compliance management by ensuring contractual obligations are tracked and fulfilled, proactively identifying and preventing contract value leakage.
* Manage and develop a team focused on achieving zero contract value leakage across the enterprise through the Statement Review Process.
* Develop a Strategy for deploying Amazon Quick Agents for CLM.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, R&D, Sales, and business units to gather requirements, prioritize features, and manage expectations.
* Facilitate governance forums (Steering committees, Product Councils) to build consensus around roadmap trade-offs.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of the full contract lifecycle: authoring, negotiation, approval workflows, execution, obligation management, and renewal.
* Familiarity with procurement and sourcing processes as they relate to contract creation and management.
* Hands-on experience with CLM platforms and comfort with API/MCP integrations, data migration, and metadata modelling.
* Understanding of eSignature tools and requirements across geographies.
* Ability to engage credibly with IT architects and developers.
* Adjacent Procurement Tools: Experience with Coupa, Hicx, Sievo for spend analytics, and process orchestration platforms such as Pega or ServiceNow.
* AI/ML-Driven Contract Analytics: Exposure to clause extraction, obligation tracking, risk scoring, and GenAI-assisted contract authoring.
* Experience in SAP and integrations is a plus.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Manage the relationship with the CLM vendor - evaluate new modules, AI features, integrations, and licensing.
* Represent MDLZ in vendor roadmap sessions and user community forums to influence product direction.

No Relocation support available

**Business Unit Summary**
-------------------------

That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.**

Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.**

title: Category Manager - AT
description:
1. Product development & range architecture

* Lead end-to-end new product development across hardside, soft side, and duffle – from consumer insight to shelf-ready product.

* Build a clear range architecture by size (cabin, medium, large, sets), material, and price ladder – and by channel: what goes to GT, MT, ecommerce, CSD, retail, and B2B, with no range overlap and sharp price-point logic.

* Benchmark features that drive choice in this category – weight, durability, wheels, locks, expandability, warranty – against competitors at every price point.

* Write detailed product briefs with the India design team and the Singapore regional design office, translating consumer needs, trend direction, and commercial parameters into actionable design direction.

* Own the development pipeline with suppliers outside India and domestic manufacturing partners – timelines, sample reviews, cost negotiations, and quality sign-offs.

* Balance global brand standards with India-specific consumer expectations, retail requirements, and price sensitivity.

Deliver products to defined price points, target margins, and launch timelines without compromising design or quality.

2. Business management & P&L

* Own the commercial performance of the company's largest category across all channels – revenue, sell-through, margins, inventory health, and return on marketing investment.

* Build and manage the annual category plan – SKU-level launch calendar, pricing architecture, channel allocation, and trade promotion budgets – built around the category's seasonal peaks.

* Work with supply chain on demand forecasting and stock planning so the right sizes and colours are available ahead of wedding, holiday, festive, and sale-event peaks.

* Define and execute consumer promotions, seasonal offers, and trade schemes for each channel, understanding the distinct levers in GT vs MT vs ecommerce vs CSD vs B2B.

* Partner with Sales so the right product is in the right channel at the right time, with a clear commercial story for each range.

Track performance closely – spotting trends, gaps, ageing stock, and risks early, and course-correcting fast.

3. BTL execution & content ownership

* Own all BTL assets for the category: catalogues, POSMs, in-store creatives, shelf-talkers, display units, and trade collateral across channels.

* Lead ecommerce content for the category – A+ and B+ content on Amazon and Flipkart, size-wise listings, and conversion-optimised imagery and copy.

Develop channel-specific content for Modern Trade activations, CSD catalogues, and B2B pitch decks and range presentations.

4. Communications support

* As the brand's lead category, Travel & Duffle is at the heart of most American Tourister campaigns. Give the Communications Head accurate category, product, and consumer inputs for ATL campaign planning and production.

* Act as the category subject-matter expert for the communications team, so product details, range logic, and consumer context are clear before campaigns go into production.

Contribute category direction for digital and ecommerce content where the range has a distinct story to tell.

5. Consumer & market intelligence

* Keep a sharp, current view of the competitive landscape in luggage – Indian competitors, D2C brands, and global entrants – across price points and channels.

* Track consumer trends across key buyer groups – first-time flyers, young professionals, families, frequent travellers, and wedding and gifting buyers – and turn insights into product and marketing action.

* Understand channel-specific purchase behaviour – what makes a trolley convert on Amazon vs what makes it sell off a GT shelf.

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose:**  
The Business Analyst’s role is to elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project stakeholders, be they customers or end-users. This includes interviewing stakeholders and gathering and compiling user requirements to create functional design specifications that can be used by development teams throughout the software lifecycle. In addition it is the responsibility of this role to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient business, financial, and operations systems in support of core organizational functions and business processes. This includes gathering and analyzing data in support of business cases, proposed projects, and systems requirements. The Business Analyst is also responsible for generating and compiling reports based on their findings, complete with probable causes and possible solutions to systems issues. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments. Moreover the Business Analyst will initiate the creation of test cases and lead business users through the testing of new solutions. Works with the QA and Training team to document system scenarios and identifies roles impacted
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborate with project managers and project sponsors to determine project scope.
* Clearly identify project stakeholders and establish user classes, as well as their characteristics.
* Conduct interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals, and identify and resolve systems issues.
* Develop and utilize standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirement specifications.
* Translate conceptual user requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Where necessary, develop prototypes of interfaces and attributes based on findings. Lead design sessions in prototyping new systems for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow
* Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Identify and establish scope and parameters of requirements analysis in order to define impact, outcome criteria, and measure-taking actions.
* Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications – verbally or through written documentation project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* Review and analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and develop strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems.
* Perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems to aid management in making implementation decisions.
* Coordinate and perform in-depth tests, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems, and other post-implementation support.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems.
* Assist in conducting research on software and hardware products to justify recommendations and to support purchasing efforts.
* Provide orientation and training to end users for all modified and new systems
* Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members.

* College diploma or university degree in the field of business administration, computer science, finance, or information systems and 5 years related work experience.
* Proven experience in overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software and hardware solutions, systems, or products
* Ability to create systematic and consistent requirements specifications in both technical and user-friendly language.
* Ability to apply statistical and other research methods into systems issues and products as required.

title: Relationship Manager Working Capital - ECG (Mid Corporates)
description:

title: Associate - Account Management (India PE)
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to **fueling decisions with expert insights**. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.

For nearly 20 years, we've helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.

### **Job Description**

As an Account Associate, you will play a vital role in driving engagement with clients across Third Bridge's Expert Calls and Library offerings. You will proactively contact investment professionals and/or consultants within our client base on a day-to-day basis, building rapport and credibility to drive end-users towards our services. Your work will be pivotal in guaranteeing the retention and growth of our account base.

**In this role you will:**

* Support Account Managers on renewals and cross-sell opportunities by working closely with them to execute on territory and account plans to achieve strategic goals
* Identify and engage inactive or potentially new users across priority accounts and to increase utilization of Third Bridge offerings
* Reiterate the value proposition of Third Bridge's services to drive usage and help embed our products in the daily workflows of end users
* Maintain constant dialogue with clients to understand their research processes and gather feedback on Third Bridge's services.
* Support clients by offering training and demo sessions on how to use Third Bridge's services.
* Maintain and update team structures, client user preferences, client investment coverage sectors and geographies, and pertinent account and contact data in our systems, ensuring tailored content and service delivery to exceed client expectations.
* Develop an awareness of client buying processes and Third Bridge sales and renewal processes to support revenue generation
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders - legal, marketing, research, sales and product teams, to ensure client requests are executed quickly and effectively.
* Attend internal and external meetings punctually and well-prepared
* Address and/or triage inbound client questions and requests; assess solutions and next steps alongside the Account Manager and execute the agreed approach
* Leverage a solid commercial understanding of AI to expand territory revenue by actively cross-selling and upselling our AI distribution solutions

  

### **Why work for us?**

What can you expect:

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* **Time Off:** Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* **Learning & Development:** Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* **Health & Well-being:** Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* **Life Cover:** Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* **Flexibility:** Embrace our work-from-anywhere policy, hybrid work options, and enjoy "Winter Fridays."
* **Recognition & Rewards:** Earn points through our colleague-to-colleague recognition program, redeemable for hotels, gift cards, charity donations, and more.
* **Snacks & Refreshments:** Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* **CSR Days:** Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

Third Bridge values your trust and is committed to the responsible management, use, and protection of personal information. By submitting a Third Bridge job application, I hereby provide Third Bridge (including Third Bridge's affiliates and relevant third-party suppliers) with my consent to collect, store and process my personal information for the purpose of recruitment administration, as well as to share such personal information with third parties for the same purpose, in accordance with the **Candidate Privacy Notice.**

That is why Third Bridge is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. description:
**About the Role**

Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.

**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce "blind spots" by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification:**

* Should have a Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information:**

**Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.

**Benefits**: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!

**Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**About PubMatic**

PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.

Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

* Experience in conducting preliminary risk analysis and understanding loan-to-value (LTV) ratios.

* Proficient in financial systems and tools with an ability to manage data accurately and efficiently.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

description:

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Brand Manager  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** Borivali West

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven Brand Manager to develop, manage, and strengthen the company's brand identity and market presence. The candidate will be responsible for brand positioning, marketing strategy, campaign planning, competitor analysis, content direction, and maintaining consistent brand communication across all channels.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market trends, digital marketing, and brand development, along with the ability to coordinate with internal teams, agencies, and external partners to execute effective brand initiatives.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

* Develop and implement brand strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Define brand positioning, value proposition, target audience, and key brand messaging.
* Establish brand guidelines to maintain consistency across marketing materials, digital platforms, and customer communications.
* Conduct market research to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and growth opportunities.
* Strengthen brand awareness, credibility, and differentiation in the market.
* Ensure consistent representation of the brand across all customer touchpoints.

2. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Conduct regular market research to understand industry trends, customer preferences, and market opportunities.
* Analyse competitor brands, marketing strategies, pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
* Identify gaps in the market and recommend strategies to improve brand competitiveness.
* Monitor customer feedback, brand perception, and market developments.
* Prepare reports and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

3. Marketing Campaigns & Brand Communication

* Plan, execute, and monitor integrated marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Develop campaign briefs, communication plans, promotional concepts, and brand messaging.
* Coordinate with digital marketing, content, design, sales, and external agencies to execute campaigns.
* Ensure all marketing materials align with the brand's tone, identity, and positioning.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.
* Support product launches, promotional activities, exhibitions, events, and brand awareness initiatives.

4. Content & Digital Brand Management

* Develop content strategies for social media, websites, email marketing, and other communication channels.
* Work with content creators, designers, and digital marketing teams to develop relevant brand assets.
* Review and approve creative content, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Maintain consistency in brand voice, visual identity, and communication standards.
* Coordinate social media campaigns and monitor engagement, reach, and audience response.
* Identify opportunities to improve the brand's digital visibility and audience engagement.

5. Product Marketing & Business Coordination

* Work closely with product, sales, and business development teams to understand product features, benefits, and target markets.
* Translate product features into clear customer benefits and compelling marketing messages.
* Develop product positioning, promotional strategies, launch plans, and marketing collateral.
* Support sales teams with presentations, brochures, product information, and other brand materials.
* Coordinate with distributors, channel partners, agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure consistent brand execution.
* Align brand initiatives with business growth, lead generation, and customer acquisition objectives.

6. Brand Performance & Budget Management

* Develop and manage brand marketing budgets in coordination with management.
* Monitor campaign spending and ensure effective utilisation of marketing resources.
* Define and track key brand performance indicators, including brand awareness, engagement, reach, lead generation, and campaign ROI.
* Prepare regular reports on campaign performance, market trends, and brand growth.
* Use data and customer insights to improve marketing effectiveness and brand performance.
* Recommend new initiatives to strengthen brand visibility and business outcomes.

7. Team & Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with internal teams, marketing agencies, vendors, and business partners.
* Manage timelines, deliverables, and priorities for brand-related projects.
* Provide creative direction and feedback to designers, content creators, and marketing team members.
* Present brand strategies, campaign plans, and performance reports to management.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned brand initiatives and marketing projects.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.
* MBA in Marketing or a relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
* 3–5 years of experience in brand management, marketing strategy, or a related role.
* Experience in developing brand strategies, managing campaigns, and conducting market research.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and marketing analytics tools.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, digital marketing, content management, and brand analytics.
* Experience in FMCG, consumer goods, home appliances, or a related industry is an advantage.

Required Skills

* Strong strategic thinking and brand-building capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Creativity, storytelling, and content evaluation skills.
* Strong analytical and market research abilities.
* Project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Understanding of consumer behaviour and marketing trends.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Budget planning, performance analysis, and problem-solving abilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Growth in brand awareness and market visibility.
* Improvement in brand engagement and audience reach.
* Successful execution of marketing campaigns within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Consistency in brand identity and communication across channels.
* Effectiveness of competitor analysis and market research.
* Performance of product launches and promotional initiatives.
* Contribution of marketing activities to qualified leads and business growth.
* Improvement in brand perception, customer engagement, and campaign ROI.

Bring your product and analysis expertise to a role with strong visibility, growth opportunities, and mobility across a global payments organization.

You will translate current-state behaviors and client needs into a prioritized backlog of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You will partner with engineering, operations, user experience, and business stakeholders to deliver agreed milestones with strong quality and risk discipline. You will help ensure solutions are scalable, user-friendly, and aligned to evolving market and regulatory expectations.

This role supports a global initiative modernizing liquidity and account services for large multinational corporate and financial institution clients. The work spans multiple regions and stakeholder groups and requires strong coordination across product, technology, and operational partners. You will help close current-state gaps while defining a clear target state that supports faster product innovation and improved client experience. Success will be measured through delivery of prioritized capabilities, clarity of documentation, and effective stakeholder alignment. title: Senior Manager - Fixed Income, Alternatives and Structured Products
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Description**

**Vice President, Product Manager - Fixed Income, Structured Products & Alternatives**

**Division:** International Wealth & Premier Banking – Wealth Management  
**Entity:** HSBC India

**Role purpose**

The role will lead the investment product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth business.

The role will translate market opportunities, client needs and regulatory developments into a compelling, commercially viable and well-governed product shelf. This means ensuring that products are relevant for clients, practical for relationship managers to distribute and sustainable for the bank.

Working closely with Markets, Investment Advisory, Risk, Compliance, Legal and regional and global Wealth teams, the role will provide end-to-end ownership of product strategy, governance, commercialization and lifecycle management.

**Key priorities include:**

  

* Accelerating the growth of Fixed Income Products, Alternative Investments and Structured Products.
* Integrating GIFT City offerings into the core investment proposition.
* Establishing Fixed Income as a central component of every relevant advisory conversation.
* Maintaining a high standard of product governance, suitability and risk management.
* The successful candidate will combine deep investment expertise with commercial judgement, disciplined execution and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Product strategy and shelf architecture**

* Define and execute the product strategy for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments across HSBC India’s wealth segments.
* Own the frameworks for product due diligence, approval, whitelisting, shelf sizing, review and retirement.
* Assess the shelf regularly to identify product gaps, client suitability considerations and opportunities to improve portfolio coverage.
* Maintain the right balance between product breadth, client relevance, governance requirements and commercial viability.
* Ensure the shelf reflects the needs and risk profiles of different client segments.

* **Fixed Income**

* Build and strengthen the Fixed Income proposition across government securities, corporate bonds and structured credit.
* Translate views on interest rates, yield curves and credit cycles into practical investment solutions.
* Develop propositions that support income generation, yield enhancement, diversification and capital preservation.
* Improve product availability, pricing, execution and servicing so that Fixed Income can be incorporated naturally into client portfolios.
* Partner with Investment Advisory and distribution teams to strengthen the role of Fixed Income in portfolio construction and client conversations.

* **Structured Products**

* Develop structured investment solutions designed to provide yield enhancement, capital protection or targeted market exposure.
* Work with Structuring, Treasury and Markets teams to create products aligned to defined client segments and investment objectives
* Evaluate underlying assets, payoff structures, liquidity, counterparty exposure and other relevant risks.
* Maintain a robust and transparent product pipeline, supported by appropriate approvals and governance.
* Ensure product documentation, client communication and distribution materials clearly explain features, risks and expected outcomes.

* **Alternative Investments**

* Grow the Alternative Investments shelf across Portfolio Management Services, Alternative Investment Funds and private-market strategies.
* Identify and assess investment managers based on track record, investment philosophy, process, risk management, governance and operational capability.
* Connect onshore and GIFT City alternatives propositions to provide clients with differentiated and complementary investment opportunities.
* Manage capacity, liquidity, operational and concentration considerations across the alternatives range.
* Increase adoption through relationship-manager engagement, targeted campaigns, training and clear investment narratives.
* Work with regional and global teams to identify relevant strategies and share best practice.

* **Product lifecycle and commercialization**

* Take investment themes and product opportunities from initial concept through business case, approval, launch, monitoring and, where appropriate, retirement.
* Develop clear commercial plans covering target clients, value proposition, pricing, distribution approach and expected financial contribution.
* Equip frontline teams across Private Banking, Premier and High Net Worth/Ultra High Net Worth segments with effective sales narratives, tools and launch support.
* Monitor assets under management, client penetration, revenue, profitability and product utilization.
* Take corrective action where commercial performance, client adoption or profitability does not meet expectations.
* Use client and frontline feedback to improve product design and distribution effectiveness.

* **Governance, risk and regulation**

* Act as the first line of defence for product integrity and ensure alignment with Group policy, applicable local regulation and HSBC’s internal governance standards.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance and Legal to assess suitability, liquidity, concentration, conduct, counterparty and other relevant risks.
* Lead product reviews, governance forums and remedial actions.
* Ensure issues are identified, escalated and resolved promptly.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their implications for the product shelf, distribution model and client experience.
* Promote a culture in which commercial ambition and responsible product management go hand in hand.
* **Market intelligence and investment insight**

  

* Monitor developments across global and Indian public and private markets.
* Assess the implications of changes in interest rates, credit conditions, market structure, regulation and investor demand.
* Convert market intelligence into clear recommendations for product strategy and shelf development.
* Work with Investment Insights teams to strengthen HSBC’s market positioning and advisory narrative.
* Provide concise, credible investment views to senior stakeholders and distribution teams.
* **Leadership and stakeholder management**

* Serve as the subject-matter expert and escalation point for Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments in HSBC India.
* Build effective working relationships with control functions, distribution leaders, Markets teams, regional and global Wealth colleagues and external partners.
* Manage relationships with asset managers, issuers and other ecosystem participants.
* Influence senior leadership through sound commercial analysis, clear investment judgement and well-structured recommendations.
* Coach junior colleagues and contribute to a strong, collaborative product management culture.
* Encourage constructive challenge and bring together different perspectives to improve outcomes.
* **Strategic initiatives**

* Lead or contribute to strategic priorities, including:
* Expanding HSBC’s investment footprint in GIFT City.
* Building investment-led digital client journeys.
* Enhancing data, analytics and management information for product governance and performance monitoring.
* Developing strategic partnerships with asset managers and other ecosystem participants.
* Improving product discovery, client engagement and frontline enablement.
* Strengthening connectivity between local, regional and global investment capabilities.

**Candidate Profile**

This is a senior product leadership role at the intersection of investment strategy, commercial growth, client outcomes and risk management.

The successful candidate will bring:

* Deep technical knowledge of Fixed Income, Structured Products and Alternative Investments.
* Experience in wealth management, investment product management, asset management, investment banking or a related financial-services environment.
* Strong understanding of product governance, due diligence, suitability and regulatory expectations.
* A track record of taking investment products from concept through approval, launch, distribution and ongoing review.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect investment propositions to client needs and business outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management and influencing skills.
* The confidence to engage senior leaders and challenge constructively where required.
* A collaborative leadership style and a commitment to developing talent.
* The ability to operate effectively across local, regional and global teams.

**Pro-Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Category/Product Manager
description:
About the Role
As the Category Manager – Flowers & Gifting, you will own the category from product selection and sourcing to pricing, margins, launch, performance and customer feedback.
You will work closely with procurement, operations, marketing, sales and vendors to build products that customers love while ensuring strong commercial performance.
Key Responsibilities
• Own the complete Flowers & Gifting category and its business performance.
• Develop and manage the product assortment across bouquets, floral arrangements, gifting products, subscriptions and seasonal offerings.
• Identify customer needs, market trends and emerging product opportunities.
• Conduct competitor and market research to identify gaps and opportunities.
• Work with vendors, florists and suppliers to develop and source products.
• Evaluate product quality, pricing, availability and commercial viability.
• Define pricing and support margin optimisation across the category.
• Develop new products and seasonal collections for occasions such as Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, festivals and corporate gifting.
• Monitor product/category sales, margins, inventory, wastage and customer feedback.
• Identify underperforming products and recommend improvements or discontinuation.
• Work closely with operations to ensure products are operationally feasible and scalable.
• Collaborate with marketing on product positioning, campaigns, launches and promotions.
• Track category KPIs and prepare regular MIS/business reviews.
• Build and maintain strong vendor and partner relationships.
• Develop processes and SOPs for product/category management.
• Continuously improve the assortment based on sales data, customer feedback and market trends.
• Identify opportunities for new categories, partnerships and revenue streams.  
Key Metrics / KPIs
• Category revenue and growth
• Gross margin / contribution margin
• Product-level profitability
• New product launches and performance
• Product sell-through
• Inventory availability
• Wastage / shrinkage
• Customer satisfaction and feedback
• Repeat purchases
• Vendor performance
• Category-level cost optimisation
What We're Looking For
• 4–8 years of experience in Category Management, Product Management, Buying, Merchandising, Business Management or a similar role.
• Experience in fresh flowers, florists, gifting, D2C, FMCG, lifestyle or consumer products is preferred.
• Strong understanding of product assortment, sourcing, pricing and margins.
• Experience working with vendors and external partners.
• Strong commercial and analytical thinking.
• Ability to understand customer behaviour and convert insights into products.
• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
• Comfortable working with Excel/MIS and business performance data.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership.
• Strong execution skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
Ideal Candidate
We are particularly interested in candidates who have owned a category or product portfolio end-to-end, from understanding customer demand and sourcing/development through pricing, launch, sales performance and continuous improvement.
Experience in fresh flowers/floristry is highly preferred, but candidates from adjacent categories such as premium gifting, FMCG, fragrance, candles, home décor, lifestyle or other consumer product businesses may also be considered.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Role Purpose:**

Providing superior customer service and ensuring operational efficiency in all Teller and clearing functions like withdrawals, deposits, transfers, customer queries on transactions

**Principal Accountabilities: Key activities and decision making areas**

**Impact on the Business**

  

* Increasing PIB registrations and migrating teller queues to the ATMs.
* Ensure that a Cross sell attempt is made for every customer interaction at the teller counter
* Process cash payments and accept cash deposits after carrying out all necessary operational checks as per guidelines.
* All operational requirements like bundling, labeling, sorting of notes is done and no soiled notes are handed over back to the customer.
* Ensure that his/her cash position is as per the laid down cash control procedures, and cash till is balanced end of day every day.
* Minimize cash differences and ensure that they are informed immediately to the Teller Supervisor.
* Maintain control over all deliverables like cheque books, Cards, pins, welcome packs, IWPs. Ensure that all collect items are handed over to the customers as per the laid down operational guidelines and after carrying out all necessary checks as mandated from time to time.
* Ensure satisfactory implementation of all audit recommendations with the assistance of the Teller Supervisor. To identify process gaps with a view to ensure compliance of the procedures.
* Ensure that ATMs are replenished and all ATM related facilities are available to the customer as required by the internal policy of the bank.

**Typical Targets and Measures:**

  

* Transaction migration to ADCs

* Cross Sell of bank products
* Teller Operations
* Error Rates

* Teller functions

description:

title: Platform and Digital Enablement Lead
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced **Platform and Digital Enablement Lead** to lead the digital enablement of our Governance, Risk and Control (GRC) landscape.

  

This is a senior leadership and hands-on delivery role responsible for bringing together GRC platforms, digital workflows, AI and automation, data quality, self-service capabilities and user adoption. The role will own the integrated product roadmap and lead the Platform, Digital Enablement and Data Quality team, while personally driving complex cross-product initiatives.

  

The successful candidate will play a key role in translating GRC standards and strategy into scalable, governed and user-focused digital solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own and drive the integrated roadmap and prioritized portfolio across GRC platforms, workflows, AI, continuous controls monitoring, digital guidance, learning, adoption and data quality.
* Translate GRC strategy and approved framework requirements into clear capabilities, sequenced releases, dependencies, resource requirements and measurable outcomes.
* Lead and develop Platform Managers, Digital Enablement Managers and the Data Quality Manager, establishing clear product ownership and delivery standards.
* Personally lead complex initiatives that bring together platform, data, AI, workflow, controls and adoption requirements.
* Act as the senior functional product authority for the GRC digital landscape, ensuring standardization, architecture alignment, auditability and a strong end-to-end user experience.
* Govern portfolio intake, business cases, prioritization, design decisions, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering teams on build capacity, technical dependencies, operational support, incident resolution and sustainable product ownership.
* Establish robust data-quality rules, reconciliations, ownership and exception processes to support trusted workflows, analytics and management reporting.
Establish responsible AI and automation guardrails, including appropriate human oversight, traceability, explainability and quality controls.  

  

**Core Comptencies:**

* Proven leadership experience managing enterprise GRC platforms, preferably SAP GRC solutions, and digital product portfolios.
* Deep expertise in GRC processes, controls, workflow design, and governance architecture.
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI, automation, and continuous controls monitoring capabilities at scale.
* Strong knowledge of SAP GRC Process Control, including data governance, data quality, and management reporting.
Ability to lead and develop teams while personally driving complex cross-functional transformation and adoption initiatives.  

  

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant experience across GRC, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation, product management, risk, controls or related areas.
* Strong experience in digital product and portfolio leadership, including roadmap prioritization and value management.
* Good understanding of GRC platforms, workflow architecture and digitally enabled risk and compliance processes.
* Experience working with AI and automation, with an understanding of responsible governance, human oversight, traceability and quality controls.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality and associated controls.
* Experience driving digital adoption, self-service capabilities and service design.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across business and technology teams and influence senior stakeholders.
Strong people leadership capabilities, combined with the ability and willingness to remain hands-on in the delivery of complex initiatives.  

  

**Key Stakeholder Relationships:**

The role will work closely with:

* Head of GRC Standards, Platform and Reporting
* Platform Managers
* Digital Enablement Managers
* Data Quality Manager
* Governance & Standard and Data & Reporting roles
* Product, Platform and Engineering teams
* GPLs, FPOs and first-line users
PEX, A&I and external auditors  

  

**Measures of Success:**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* Delivery of portfolio milestones
* Requirement-to-release cycle time
* Release quality and critical defects
* Platform availability and incident trends
* Self-service and active adoption
* Data-quality rule pass rates
* Reduction in manual effort
User confidence and support demand  

  

**What You Will Be Accountable For:**

You will be accountable for maintaining an integrated and prioritized roadmap across platform, AI, self-service, adoption and data quality; ensuring the functional quality, usability, auditability and adoption of GRC digital products; maintaining reliable data controls; and ensuring responsible governance of AI and automation with appropriate human oversight

**Department:** Marketing – Digital

The Campaign Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring and optimising multichannel marketing campaigns across WhatsApp, push notifications, email and in-app messaging.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with **Clevertap and Infobip or any CRM tools**, a strong understanding of audience segmentation and marketing automation, and the ability to translate campaign data into actionable insights that improve engagement and retention.

**1. Campaign Planning and Execution**

* Plan and execute campaigns across WhatsApp, push notifications, email and in-app messaging.
* Manage campaign calendars, timelines, audience lists, content requirements and scheduling.
* Ensure timely and accurate campaign deployment across multiple medical specialties.
* Coordinate with content, design, product and business teams to deliver campaigns as planned.

**2. Clevertap and Marketing Automation**

* Manage audience segmentation, campaign targeting and personalised communication using Clevertap.
* Build and optimise automated journeys for onboarding, activation, retention and reactivation.
* Set up event-based campaigns and behavioural triggers, where supported by the platform and product instrumentation.
* Use engagement and user activity data to identify opportunities for improving doctor engagement.

* Handle audience uploads, template coordination, campaign scheduling and delivery monitoring.
