* Monitor messaging quality and compliance with applicable platform policies and communication requirements.

**4. Campaign Analytics and Optimisation**

* Track key performance indicators such as delivery rate, open or view rate, click-through rate, conversions, activation, reactivation and retention.
* Prepare regular campaign performance reports and dashboards.
* Analyse campaign performance across channels, specialties, audience segments and content categories.
* Conduct A/B tests on messaging, creative formats, timing and audience segments.
* Recommend data-backed improvements to increase engagement and campaign effectiveness.

**5. Doctor Engagement and Retention**

* Develop targeted campaigns to encourage doctors to explore Medgami’s content, communities, journal summaries, videos and other platform features.
* Design re-engagement strategies for inactive users and improve repeat app usage.
* Work with relevant teams to identify engagement drop-offs and improve user journeys.
* Support campaigns for new feature launches, educational content, webinars and conference-related initiatives.

* Coordinate with product and technology teams on tracking events, deep links, UTM parameters and campaign integrations.

* 10 years of experience in digital campaign management, CRM marketing or marketing automation.
* Hands-on experience with **Clevertap and Infobip** is strongly preferred.
* Practical experience with WhatsApp Business messaging, push notifications, email campaigns and in-app communication.
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation, automated journeys, behavioural targeting and lifecycle marketing.
* Proficiency in campaign analytics, Excel/Google Sheets and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and recommend optimisation strategies.
* Strong organisational, communication, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.

If interested, please apply on the Job Posting at the earliest.

title: Product Manager - Sustainability & Climate AI Solutions
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

We are seeking an **AI Product Manager** to own the building and commercialization of new AI solutions across our Sustainability and Climate (S&C) product suite. Responsibilities will include owning and expanding our new MCP / MSCI AI Insights solution and leading the build and commercialization of new AI agents for the S&C business.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of data, data distribution (API, Snowflake, etc), emerging AI applications, and the needs and workflows of investors and other regulated financial services clients. You will work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Data Operations, Legal and Client Coverage colleagues to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities that unlock value at scale. You will interact with clients to understand their evolving needs in relation to AI, and with potential third party partners to establish new business growth opportunities.

Your Key Responsibilities:

* **Product & solution vision (cross-functional leadership):** Own the product vision for AI interfaces and agent solutions — including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights and agentic workflow tools — identifying client needs and use cases, sizing opportunities, creating prototypes with relevant cross-functional stakeholders and validating ideas with clients, translating prototypes into requirements and acceptance criteria for engineering, and leading launch and commercialization with cross-functional colleagues.
* **Ownership of the S&C MCP and AI Insights interface:** Own the ongoing running and enhancement of our new S&C MCP, and accompanying AI Insights platform experience on MSCI ONE.
* **Partnership with Product, data, and research experts:** Work closely with product, data, and research experts to define target use cases, understand client workflows (today and in future AI-first world) and ground truth for AI products, and map the datasets, dashboards, and sources those features draw from.
* **Documentation and enablement:** Own and build documentation for internal training, client enablement, and ongoing feature updates, keeping it aligned with the underlying data model as datasets, factors, and dashboards evolve.
* **Sustainability and climate data expertise:** Maintain a working understanding of MSCI's S&C datasets and the data structures and taxonomy unique to each, using that expertise to validate AI-generated outputs against methodology before they reach clients.
* **Distribution and delivery mechanisms:** Understand how S&C data reaches its clients via API, Datafeeds, Snowflake, and platforms such as MSCI ONE, and partner with engineering on the data architecture questions that affect how MCP tools and AI Insights query and present that data, and ensure S&C data is AI-ready for consumption by client AI assistants and third-party AI connectors. Partner closely with the Product owner for S&C Data Distribution to ensure all S&C datasets are transformed to be “AI-ready” and high-performing within our AI tools.
* **Senior stakeholder communication:** Present product vision, roadmap, and business cases — including pricing and packaging options — to senior stakeholders for alignment and investment, and support client AI-governance and due-diligence questionnaires with Legal and Compliance.
* **Client-facing validation:** Lead client presentations, demos, and working sessions with senior client stakeholders to validate direction and build advocacy ahead of launch, representing the voice of the client in prioritization trade-offs.
* **Roadmap ownership and success metrics:** Own the end-to-end roadmap for AI interfaces and agent solutions, including S&C data AI-readiness, MCP, AI Insights, and agentic tools. Report adoption, quality, and business-impact metrics to leadership on a regular cadence.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

* 7+ years in product management or other related role, including ownership of AI/ML-enabled or data-distribution products — financial data, ESG/sustainability, or index/analytics experience preferred.
* Solid understanding of sustainability and climate data domains (ESG ratings & scores, sustainability data, carbon emissions and climate risk metrics, etc) and comfort with complex, evolving data taxonomies.
* Working knowledge of AI/LLM concepts: retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, vector embeddings, similarity scoring, hallucination mitigation, agentic AI architectures, and MCP or comparable tool-calling protocols.
* Familiarity with data distribution mechanisms — APIs, data feeds, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), and client-facing UI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements for engineering and user documentation for clients.
* Strong executive presence — comfortable presenting to senior internal stakeholders and high-profile client stakeholders.
* Track record of excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Research, Programme Management, Legal, Client Coverage and Marketing.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm and curiosity for learning about and using cutting-edge AI tools and technologies

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.

**You Will:**

* Drive the product roadmap and execution for one or more master data domains by deeply understanding business needs, data quality challenges, and the evolving enterprise data landscape.
* Advance a unified approach to master data — including product, customer, vendor, and financial data domains — ensuring consistency, accuracy, and accessibility across the organization.
* Design and improve data governance processes, data stewardship workflows, and master data lifecycle management experiences that empower business users and reduce friction.
* Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Analytics, Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Business Operations teams to define, develop, and launch master data solutions and capabilities.
* Drive automation and continuous improvement to eliminate data quality issues, reduce manual data handling, and deliver measurable business outcomes such as time savings, cost reduction, and improved decision-making.
* Partner with data and analytics teams to understand how master data flows across systems, identify gaps, and lead initiatives that improve data reliability and trustworthiness across the enterprise.
* Monitor and analyze the health and adoption of master data products, using insights to inform the ongoing transformation roadmap.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of analytics tools such as Looker or Adobe Analytics, as well as data pipeline or integration concepts, preferred.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

**What the team owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.

* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

title: Product Manager
description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

**What we do...**

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Product Manager role...**

This is a full-stack product role with a primary focus on GDS connectivity within the distribution portfolio. You will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and opportunity identification through requirements definition, delivery, go-to-market, and post-launch evaluation. Working closely with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will shape product direction, support feature delivery, and define clear success measures to ensure outcomes align with customer needs and business goals.

**What you'll do...**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and customer validation through requirements definition, delivery, launch, and evaluation.
* Shape and execute the product roadmap in alignment with customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer-centred research and business analysis with hoteliers, connectivity partners, and internal subject matter experts.
* Identify, define, prioritise, and validate product opportunities, features, and enhancements.
* Partner with the Design and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, shape solutions, and support effective delivery.
* Prioritise and maintain the product backlog, ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-value work.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to plan releases, manage dependencies, and communicate progress and milestones.
* Support go-to-market planning, product positioning, internal enablement, and customer and partner communications.
* Define and monitor success metrics, including adoption, customer satisfaction, revenue impact, delivery performance, product-market fit, and operational quality.
* Stay informed on market, customer, competitor, and technology developments, including the effective use of AI tools and AI-augmented workflows.

**What you'll have...**

* 5+ years’ product management experience in B2B SaaS, travel, hospitality technology, or a related domain.
* Experience in hotel distribution, channel management, revenue management, connectivity, GDS integrations, or another travel-related domain is highly desirable.
* Experience working with API-based products, system integrations, and cross-functional delivery teams in Agile or Kanban environments.
* A proven track record of delivering products or features that achieve customer adoption, commercial outcomes, and measurable business value.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and technical business analysis skills, with confidence using customer insights and data to inform decisions.
* Creative and adaptable problem-solving skills, with the ability to think outside the box, develop practical solutions to complex challenges, and demonstrably leverage AI tools and capabilities to accelerate outcomes.
* A solid understanding of product management practices and the end-to-end product lifecycle, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs across customer, commercial, technical, and operational considerations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional workshops and build collaborative relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to meet customers, connectivity partners, and internal stakeholders, including at our head office in Sydney, Australia.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Senior Product Manager- Technical
description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

Senior Product Manager- TechnicalOverview

• We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise• We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behaviour beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data• We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and moreThe MasterCard Data & Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services. This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution. Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard • Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value • Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products• Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams• Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments• Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs  
  
Role  

* Own, define and deliver end-to-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch
* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities
* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

• Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features•  
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives  

* Oversee timely and high-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements
* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals
* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team
* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership
* Promote internal and external feature adoption
* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support
* Provide input into product pricing and our go-to-market strategy
* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  
All About You  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness
* Requires minimal supervision/assistance
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

• Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)•
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

• Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus• Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Manager - Transformation Programme Management

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Guidance Notes:**

This job profile provides a broad overview of the Job Category Client Management and is not intended to exhaustively describe the role.

**Job Profile: GCB 5**

The Global Payment Solutions (GPS) Account Manager (AM) is responsible for the global satisfaction of a portfolio of GPS clients. The purpose of this role is to ensure clients receive a superior service experience both locally and globally; to be a client’s single point of contact for service for those complex queries that are fall above and beyond basic transactional queries.

The Account Manager’s portfolio will be a mix of top tier, highly complex GPS clients and complex clients. The Account Manager will be accountable for the overall satisfaction with GPS produts and services and support the broadening and deepening of these client relationships to drive commercial outcomes for the GPS business.

This includes overseeing execution of query management for the client, oversight of transactional activity, providing insights to clients on how to optimize through Client Service Reviews, coordination of a clients global Treasury and Cash Management initiatives and projects, and proactively managing the GPS client relationship on a day to day basis. Depending on the complexity and geography of the client this role will either lead the client relationship or play a supporting role on a global squad covering the client.

**Basic Job Expectations**

* Manage the liquidity and cash management needs of a portfolio of Financial Institutions, Multi-National Corporations and Local Corporates. Maintain relationships with key influencers in the client’s local or regional Treasury and Finance organisation.
* Be accountable for the retention of annual revenue of your portfolio of clients, including capturing opportunities and supporting growth of your clients (revenue targets included in scorecard)

* Accountable for the identification of opportunities to deliver Client Service excellence locally and regionally; effectively managing any risks and issues.
* Responsible for resolving assigned queries.
* Accountable for monitoring and guiding the completion of all global queries and local basic queries that may be assigned to others.
* The role holder must have a strong understanding of the cash management business including identifying and dealing with actual or potential business or relationship risks.
* Strong written and oral communication skills; must be able to put complex product and/or technical information into simple terms.
* Maintain a client footprint with the basic information required to deliver a superior client experience.

**Senior Account Manager**

In addition to the above activities, the **Senior Account Manager** will also be:

* + The point of escalation for other stakeholders supporting the client and for the client themselves on all GPS Service engagements when they are the lead.
  + The point person to coordinate projects focused on existing business retention (i.e. GBS/TWIST billing global setups, file format conversions, Connect Digital migration).
  + Will proactively review local/regional client activity and existing solutions with GPS in order to identify any opportunities to improve the client’s experience with HSBC. This includes but is not limited to; reducing service queries and reject/error rates, streamlining processing time, improved data/payment security, identify opportunities to streamline client processes, eliminate redundancy, strengthen relationships, and increase wallet share by recomending new products & solutions that will benefit the client’s business operations.
  + Will provide analysis and recommendations to senior management on client focus, attrition, and engagement.

Monitor metrics and performance indicators of service levels and develop and implement remedial actions as needed.

* Continuously adapt to balance and prioritise different demands of their portfolio while managing requirements from multiple stakeholders

**Customer Engagement**

* Engage with their client’s operational and Treasury teams as needed or agreed to with the client. This includes but is not limited to a client’s Treasury Operations and IT teams and the wider Finance and Treasury Organization.
* Gather and maintain specific intimate knowledge of their client’s Treasury operations and how they interface with HSBC products and services.
* Engage and work cross functionally with various internal partners (Operations, Technology, Sales, and the RM) coordinating client interactions and recommendations relating to existing GPS business. Must be flexible and willing to go outside work assignment boundaries to ensure their client’s satisfaction.
* Develop and deliver standard Client Service Reviews on an ad hoc basis using key client metrics to proactively identify issues and trends including things like payment flows, rejection and return rates, and industry benchmarks. Work with the client and internal stakeholders to remediate and improve metrics to benefit the client.

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Strong knowledge of local and global cash management and clearing services, products, and techniques.
* Proven ability in identifying and meeting customer needs through matching a broad range of products and services.
* Ability to understand a customer’s business and the fundamentals of running a business.
* Good level of business acumen and commercial awareness, including economic, cultural, procedural, and regulatory issues
* Strong range of communication skills, including written, verbal, and the ability to deliver compelling presentations.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to thrive in a complex matrix environment with several stakeholders with differing goals/expectations.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced work environment; continually changing lines of communication, technological advances etc.
* Excellent time management, planning and organization skills with ability to manage multiple time sensitive tasks.
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to travel.

**Desirable**

* Previous banking experience working with FIs/Corporates in a relationship or account management role. Specific experience with large multi-national corporations or financial institutions including Global/Regional HQ names will be an advantage.
* Knowledge of day-to-day workings of a Corporate Treasury environment, foreign exchange, intercompany loans, payroll, and payments.
* Knowledgeable about our competitors’ products and services, strategies, and client relationship practices.
* Broad knowledge of HSBC Group companies and product ranges

**Pro Tip:** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

**Additional Notes:** Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.

**Role Overview:**

The Product Growth Manager will drive scalable growth for key products by identifying high-impact opportunities, translating market and user insights into product strategy, and partnering across functions to deliver measurable business outcomes. This role blends technical product management, experimentation, and go-to-market thinking to improve user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and revenue.

**What will you do at Fynd?**

* Define and execute product growth strategies aligned to business goals and product vision.
* Analyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify growth opportunities.
* Partner with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and business teams to launch and optimize growth initiatives.
* Own experimentation frameworks, including A/B testing, hypothesis definition, prioritization, and result analysis.
* Translate user insights and data into product requirements, feature enhancements, and roadmap recommendations.
* Monitor key growth metrics such as acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, engagement, and monetization.
* Work closely with technical teams to ensure scalable implementation of growth features and product improvements.
* Communicate progress, insights, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership through clear reporting and presentations.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 5-8 years of experience in product management, product growth, or a similar role
* Strong understanding of product metrics such as acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and revenue
* Experience working with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and operations
* Proficiency in using data to identify opportunities, define experiments, and measure business impact

**Good to have**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree
* Experience in a technology company or high-growth digital product environment
* Exposure to SQL, analytics tools, or product analytics platforms
* Experience with growth experimentation frameworks and lifecycle optimization
* Prior work on user acquisition or monetization initiatives

**What do we offer?**

**Growth**

At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we’re seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.

We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.

* Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we’ll reimburse the costs to support your development.

We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.

* Regular community engagement and team-building activities
* Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture

**Wellness**

Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents

We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.

Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!

title: Senior Technical Product Manager
description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Role Overview**
=================

We are seeking a technically strong and execution-oriented Technical Product Manager to help advance the Windchill+ SaaS platform. The role partners closely with Product Management, Platform R&D, Quality Assurance, Cloud Engineering, and service operations teams to translate platform requirements into well-defined, executable development backlogs.

The immediate focus is platform release execution performed directly with R&D teams. This includes release readiness, technical improvements, security and compliance changes, infrastructure evolution, validation, retrofitting, and other work required to advance and maintain the platform. The TPM will operate under the mentorship of the lead Windchill+ Platform TPM while progressively assuming ownership of recurring backlog, dependency, and release-management responsibilities.

Over time, the role will expand into broader service-level improvements. The TPM will help define how platform capabilities affect the Windchill+ service experience and will apply Design for Operations thinking earlier in the development lifecycle. Design for Operations is an evolving practice within the organization, and this role will help establish practical ways to incorporate operational requirements, installed-base impacts, customer enablement, and service readiness into backlog definition.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

The responsibilities below represent a superset of the work this role may perform. Actual day-to-day focus will vary over the course of any given release and across releases. The TPM is not expected to perform all of these responsibilities all of the time, or to do so without support from the broader team.

* Partner directly with Windchill+ Platform R&D teams to define, refine, prioritize, and maintain executable product backlogs.

* Translate product, service, security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear deliverables, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and release outcomes.

* Own day-to-day TPM execution for assigned platform initiatives through discovery, planning, development, validation, and release.

* Coordinate platform readiness for Windchill product releases, maintenance releases, security updates, supporting component changes, and installed-base retrofits.

* Work with engineering and QA leads to assess technical approaches, dependencies, resource needs, delivery estimates, validation requirements, and release feasibility.

* Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, story acceptance, and TPM readouts with globally distributed Agile teams.

* Manage work across Product Management, Platform R&D, QA, Cloud Engineering, operations, integrated products, and shared services, converting dependencies into explicit backlog and accountable ownership.

* Facilitate technical discovery and design spikes when requirements, architecture, or operational impacts are not sufficiently understood.

* Maintain a reliable view of planned, completed, deferred, and at-risk work; identify decisions and escalations early enough to protect delivery.

* Balance urgent tactical needs with longer-term platform objectives and roadmap priorities.

* Begin applying Design for Operations to assigned work by considering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, support, maintenance, security, upgrades, retrofitting, validation, and customer enablement during backlog definition.

* Continuously strengthen technical and product-management expertise through hands-on collaboration, mentoring, and formal or self-directed learning.

**Growth Opportunities**
========================

As experience and organizational practices mature, the TPM will expand from hands-on platform execution into broader service-level ownership:

* Independently manage multiple platform workstreams across releases, including more complex cross-team and installed-base changes.

* Lead selected Design for Operations assessments and help evolve the organization's methods, templates, and working practices.

* Define how proposed capabilities change the experience for customers, administrators, partners, support teams, and service operators.

* Own selected service improvements from definition through release, connecting the intended service experience to the required platform, automation, documentation, enablement, and operational backlog.

* Partner with the Offering Owner on changes that affect the Service Guide, service catalog, customer commitments, or broader offering definition.

* Provide broader Windchill+ TPM coverage, enabling the lead platform TPM to concentrate on strategic, cross-offering, and technically complex initiatives.

**Skills and Knowledge**
========================

**Required**
------------

* Strong experience with enterprise software development, platform engineering, cloud services, DevOps, systems integration, or SaaS delivery teams.

* Demonstrated ability to translate technical and business requirements into an executable Agile backlog.

* Experience writing deliverables, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.

* Experience prioritizing backlogs and performing story or release acceptance.

* Working knowledge of Scrum, Agile planning, backlog refinement, and iterative software delivery.

* Ability to understand complex technical dependencies and drive decisions across multiple engineering and stakeholder teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, architects, QA engineers, operations teams, Product Managers, and senior stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment across globally distributed teams.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, science, mathematics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Windchill installation, deployment, administration, integrations, or functional capabilities.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure or other public or private cloud platforms.

* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, Docker, Kubernetes, or enterprise application deployment technologies.

* Familiarity with Java-based enterprise application architectures, REST APIs, scripting, Linux, and secure communication technologies.

* Experience with Jira or similar requirements and backlog management systems.

* Understanding of application security, compliance, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational validation.

* Experience supporting SaaS releases, platform updates, maintenance releases, security updates, or installed-base retrofits.

* Exposure to service design, operational readiness, or product-to-operations transition practices.

**Experience**
==============

* Typically 6 or more years of relevant experience in enterprise software development, technical product management, engineering delivery, cloud services, systems integration, deployment, or customer-facing technical roles.

* Formal Product Manager or Product Owner experience is valuable but is not required when the candidate has demonstrated ownership of complex technical delivery and engineering backlog.

* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams or systems is strongly preferred.

* The candidate should be comfortable starting in a hands-on execution role and growing into broader service-level ownership.

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

Our independence means we provide reliable, impartial and informed advice. All of this helps us stand by the purpose that drives us every single day; shaping a better future together.

  

LRQA currently operates across 50 countries, has more than 2,500 colleagues, generates £315m in revenue, and supports more than 60,000 clients across a diverse range of sectors and markets.

  

**The next chapter for LRQA**

The future is exciting and rapidly changing. New challenges and opportunities are arising all the time. We’re adapting to these challenges by expanding our portfolio of services and aiming to become the leading digitally enabled assurance provider.

  

With solid expertise and heritage in our sector, coupled with well-timed accelerated investment and a leadership team that is fully committed to delivering our vision, LRQA’s next chapter is set to be an exciting, transformational period of growth. * Experience leading science and technology discussions and influencing strategy for ML- or science-driven products.

Preferred Qualifications

### **About Cloud Secure Edge**

Cloud Secure Edge (CSE) is SonicWall's cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that provides enterprise-grade Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), VPN-as-a-Service, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) capabilities. CSE enables organizations to enforce least-privilege access policies across managed and unmanaged devices, continuously verifying user identity, device posture, and contextual signals before granting access to private applications, SaaS resources, and internet destinations. This is a high-growth, strategically critical product line at the center of SonicWall's SASE transformation.

### **The Role**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape and drive SonicWall Cloud Secure Edge. In this role, you will connect engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success—translating market needs and customer insights into product direction. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding and sharp commercial instinct, influencing the platform's evolution to deliver measurable security outcomes for SonicWall customers and partners.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Influence and help define the Cloud Secure Edge product vision and strategy; own the execution of the multi-quarter roadmap aligned with SonicWall's SASE and Zero Trust go-to-market objectives.
* Prioritize features and capabilities based on customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and engineering feasibility.
* Develop and present business cases for new investments to executive leadership, including TAM analysis, win/loss data, and projected impact on ARR.

#### **Technical Product Ownership**

* Partner closely with engineering leadership to define requirements, write detailed specifications, and make informed trade-off decisions on scope, architecture, and delivery timelines.
* Drive integration strategy across SonicWall's security portfolio, including firewalls, endpoint agents, and threat intelligence services.
* Ensure extensibility for MSP automation workflows and third-party integrations (SIEM, SOAR, IdP).
* Evaluate and influence platform architecture decisions related to multi-tenancy, scalability, and cloud-native deployment models.

#### **Zero Trust & SASE Domain Leadership**

* Serve as the internal subject matter expert on ZTNA, SSE, and SASE frameworks, educating cross-functional teams and informing competitive positioning.
* Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape (Zscaler, Palo Alto Prisma, Cloudflare, Netskope) to identify differentiation opportunities and parity gaps.
* Translate regulatory and compliance trends (NIST Zero Trust Architecture, CISA guidelines) into actionable product requirements.

#### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Go-to-Market**

* Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop positioning, messaging, competitive battle cards, and sales enablement content.
* Work directly with strategic customers and MSP partners to validate product direction, conduct design-partner programs, and gather feedback.
* Support sales engineering teams with technical deep-dives, RFP responses, and proof-of-concept engagements.
* Define and track product success metrics including adoption, activation, retention, NPS, and ARR contribution.

### **Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on network security, cloud security, or identity/access management products.
* Deep working knowledge of ZTNA, SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, and/or VPN technologies and their underlying architectures.
* Proven track record of shipping cloud-native or SaaS products at scale, with experience managing multi-tenant platforms.
* Strong technical fluency: ability to engage with engineering teams on API design, microservices architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience working with channel and MSP partner ecosystems in the cybersecurity space.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to C-level stakeholders..

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience at a cybersecurity vendor in the SASE or SSE market (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Cloudflare, Netskope, Fortinet).
* Familiarity with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and their integration patterns with ZTNA platforms.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or relevant cloud/security credentials.
* Experience with agile product development methodologies and tools (Jira, Aha!, Productboard).
* Background in data-driven product management with proficiency in analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Pendo).
* AI fluency and demonstrated ability to prototype with AI tools: comfortable leveraging LLMs, copilots, and generative AI to accelerate research, ideation, spec writing, and rapid prototyping of product concepts.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

The role will turn consumer, shopper, category and business data into clear choices that strengthen brand strategy, accelerate innovation and unlock sustainable growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Shape portfolio and brand strategy
  
  

* Build and deliver a focused learning agenda aligned to the portfolio’s biggest growth questions and commercial priorities.
* Synthesize consumer, category, cultural and competitive signals to identify penetration, frequency, premiumisation and market-level growth opportunities.
* Partner brand and category teams to translate insights into sharper strategies, propositions, communication and activation choices.

Lead insight-driven innovation and mix development
  
  

* Guide innovation and renovation from opportunity identification through concept, product, pack, pricing, communication and launch learning.
* Design fit-for-purpose qualitative and quantitative learning plans, balancing rigour, agility, cost and speed.
* Bring deep consumer and cultural understanding to create distinctive, locally relevant mixes and improve first-time-right decision making.

Connect data to action
  
  

* Work Hands-on and deep dive into Retail Audit, Household Panel, Brand Tracking, point-of-sale, digital commerce, media, internal sales and other available sources to deliver one coherent business story.
* Lead regular performance reviews and deep dives, moving beyond reporting to diagnose the “why”, identify growth opportunities and recommend actions.
* Partner stakeholders on marketing effectiveness, pricing, portfolio and channel questions using advanced analytics and experimentation where relevant.

Build consumer and shopper closeness
  
  

* Deepen understanding of shoppers, retail environments and emerging channels, translating learning into implementable actions for Marketing and Sales.
* Bring the outside-in through immersions, trend work, competitive intelligence and direct consumer connection.
* Champion a culture of consumer obsession by making insights accessible, memorable and easy to use.

Influence and deliver with excellence
  
  

* Act as a trusted, objective thought partner who can challenge constructively, resolve debates through evidence and influence stakeholders.
* Manage research partners end to end, including briefing, methodology selection, quality, timelines, budgets and action-oriented delivery.
* Experiment with agile, digital and AI-enabled approaches while protecting research quality, responsible data use and confidentiality.

Job Specifications
  
  

* Post-graduate qualification; an MBA or specialization in marketing, consumer behaviour, analytics or research is advantageous.
* Approximately 5-10 years of relevant experience in consumer and market insights, analytics or research, gained in FMCG and/or a high-quality research or consulting organization.
* Hands-on experience across qualitative and quantitative research, with strong capability in translating learning into commercial recommendations.
* Experience working with syndicated and business data such as Retail Audit, Household Panel, Brand Tracking, POS/e-commerce and internal sales data is critical and prior experience in it is an added advantage
* Strong strategic thinking, storytelling and presentation skills, with the confidence to simplify complexity and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* A curious, collaborative and action-oriented mindset, with high standards of ownership, ethics and execution.

The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience


**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2\+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10\+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5\-6 Years.
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non\-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams.
* Technical Skillset \- AI / Automation Activation, Adoption \& Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization.
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy.
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.
* Supports creation and management of feature or activation roadmaps with manager guidance .
* Demonstrates learning agility and applies new ideas to improve work .
* Adopts and scales practical innovations that improve AI activation and business adoption.
* Contributes to playbooks, standards, and ways of working across the activation community.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience with GenAI and LLM\-enabled workflows is preferred.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Engineering Product Manager | 15+ Years
description:
Meet the Team
  
We are a small, agile, and highly collaborative unit within the provider mobility business unit, passionate about delivering strategic cloud native packet core, IoT, and SaaS solutions for some of the service providers and enterprises. Nuveen is seeking a seasoned leader with 15\+ years of experience to own the strategy, roadmap, and end\-to\-end delivery of our enterprise Data Lakehouse. The successful candidate will have deep credibility with both engineering teams and senior business stakeholders, a track record of building platforms and the organizational maturity to navigate competing priorities across multiple lines of business.


**Key Responsibilities of the Role**

* Own the multi\-year vision and strategy for the Data Lakehouse, positioning it as foundational infrastructure for the enterprise's data and AI ambitions

title: Product Manager at Dolphin Studios
description:
A product manager defines, develops, and manages a product's entire lifecycle, bridging customer needs with business objectives to create a successful, viable product. Key responsibilities include defining product strategy and roadmaps, conducting market research to understand user needs, coordinating cross\-functional teams (engineering, marketing, sales), ensuring the product aligns with company goals, overseeing product launches, and tracking product performance post\-launch.
At Dolphin Studio LLC, we’re proud to offer innovative products that meet the needs of our customers. To help us continue expanding our offerings, we’re in search of an experienced product manager to lead a multidisciplinary development team. The ideal candidate will have a keen eye for gaps in consumer product offerings and an innovative mindset for filling them. This person should be a highly skilled market analyst with a proven ability to strategize the full lifecycle of a product, from conception to release. We’re looking for a confident leader who can guide cross\-functional teams in the creation of products that improve customer experience and grow market share.

Drive the product\- and business\-planning processes for cross\-functional teams
Analyze customer needs, current market trends, and potential partnerships from an ROI and build\-vs.\-buy perspective
Assess current competitor offerings and seek opportunities for differentiation

Create product strategy documents that describe business cases, high\-level use cases, technical requirements, revenue, and ROI
Analyze market data to develop sales strategies, and define product objectives for effective marketing communications

Strong experience in a dynamic product management role
Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle
High effectiveness in managing cross\-functional teams
Experience in delivering finely tuned product marketing strategies
Exceptional writing and editing skills, combined with strong presentation and public speaking skills
